info.name: RideShare Platform API
info.description:
Industrial Rideshare Platform — complete API collection.

## Setup
1. Set `base_url` variable to `http://localhost:3000`
2. Run **Admin Login** → token auto-saves to `admin_token`
3. Run **Rider Verify OTP** → token auto-saves to `rider_token`
4. Run **Driver Verify OTP** → token auto-saves to `driver_token`
5. All subsequent requests use these tokens automatically.

## Response Format
```json
{ "SUCCESS": true, "MESSAGE": <data> }
{ "SUCCESS": true, "MESSAGE": [...], "COUNT": n, "PAGINATION": { "currentPage", "itemsPerPage", "totalItems", "totalPages" } }
{ "SUCCESS": false, "MESSAGE": "error reason" }
```
